text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. Instead of just reading words as symbols, NLP allows machines to grasp the meaning behind sentences. This technology powers many tools we use daily, such as machine translation, which instantly converts text from one language to another. Another common application is sentiment analysis, where computers examine social media posts or reviews to decide if the overall feeling is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, NLP is the brain behind chatbots, which can answer customer questions naturally. By combining language rules with machine learning, NLP continues to make human-computer interaction smoother and more intuitive.
